changes.title: Alito says Supreme Court can't stem rise of emergency appeals, 'not pleased' with Trump's rhetoric
changes.summary: The justice told The Associated Press in a rare interview that the rhetoric about the court from Trump and his administration doesn't sit well with him.

changes.title: Spain Cancels Arrest Warrant for Carles Puigdemont, Catalan Separatist Leader
changes.summary: The Spanish Supreme Court canceled an arrest warrant for Carles Puigdemont, who has been living in self-imposed exile in Belgium.

changes.title: The Alito Court: A rare interview with the influential Supreme Court justice
changes.summary: Justice Samuel Alito discussed his opinion in the Dobbs decision overturning Roe v. Wade, the leaked draft and its aftermath, same-sex marriage rights and why he's not retiring yet.

changes.title: Conservative US supreme court justice Samuel Alito hints at retirement in interview
changes.summary: Alito, 76, delivers comment in rare interview with CBS News scheduled to air on Monday Samuel Alito , the conservative US supreme court justice, has said “I think I have to” contemplate retiring every year at his age. changes.title: The Supreme Court faces another term jam-packed with controversy
changes.summary: The Supreme Court term opens on Monday with big test cases on religion, guns and climate change. Plus, the emergency docket keeps popping. (Image credit: Roberto Schmidt).

changes.title: Are Trump’s Official Papers His Personal Property?
changes.summary: The administration argues that presidential papers are like those of Supreme Court justices.

changes.title: Supreme Court Stands Up to Trump on Mail Voting and a Few Key Issues
changes.summary: The justices take their time and pick their spots, but they have rejected presidential initiatives on tariffs, citizenship, the National Guard — and now the coming election.

changes.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump Administration Plan to Screen Mail-In Ballots
changes.summary: The Trump administration had asked the justices to allow a new Postal Service plan to screen ballots just weeks before the midterm elections.

changes.title: With Trump’s Plans Blocked, States Work to Restore Trust in Mail Voting
changes.summary: President Trump’s efforts to restrict mail voting ahead of the midterms were thwarted by the Supreme Court, but they have sowed confusion and doubt among some voters.

changes.title: The Supreme Court Is Considering Trump’s Mail Voting Plan. Here’s What to Know.
changes.summary: The administration’s plan to screen mail-in ballots remains blocked as the Supreme Court reviews challenges to new U.S. Postal Service ballot rules.
